scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w functions && firebase deploy -P dev --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,functions
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w functions && firebase deploy -P prod --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,functions
scripts.build:android: cd app && npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.build:android:prod: cd app && npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "npm run test -w functions"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:app && npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules
